## 🇩🇪 German — Daily Phrases (3)
1. **Lass dir Zeit damit.** — [lahs deer tsait dah-MIT] — *Take your time with it.*
2. **Das spricht mich total an.** — [dahs shprisht mish toh-TAHL ahn] — *That really appeals to me.*
3. **Mir fällt gerade nichts ein.** — [meer fehlt geh-RAH-deh nikhts ain] — *Nothing comes to mind right now.*
